title: Prescriptions Store Rule: Handling Kept on Declined Non-Controlled Balances
content:
When a patient declines the owed balance of a Kestrel Prescriptions record in the Non-Controlled Acute Prescription, Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription or Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription class, the store keeps a non-controlled handling amount that grows with the time the balance has stood.

## Rule

The non-controlled handling amount counts the calendar days from the short fill's dispensing date, as day 0, to today:

| Days from the short fill's dispensing date to today | Handling amount kept |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 1.00 |
| 1 up to fewer than 4 (1, 2 or 3) | 0.50 |
| 0 (declined on the dispensing date) | nothing |

The handling amount kept is taken off the non-controlled undelivered value, and the undelivered value less the handling amount is never below zero.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical short fill dispensed on day 0)

- Declined on day 3: 0.50 kept. Declined on day 4: 1.00 kept.
- Declined on day 0: nothing kept. Declined on day 1: 0.50 kept.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

An undelivered value of 8.00 on a balance declined on day 6 keeps 1.00, leaving 7.00. An undelivered value of 0.30 declined on day 2 keeps 0.50; the value after the handling amount is never below zero, so 0.00.
